L008.space_policy: All actual visible whitespace-decoded glyphs are aligned and counted with exact source byte/dictionary evidence; empty-outline spaces and generated whitespace remain unchanged. Ambiguous alignment fails closed.
L008.cache_key: actual PDF dictionary object plus dictionary bytes; effective encoding hash bound separately
L008.font_stream_scope: font_streams inventories embedded Type1 programs only; Type3 character programs have separate glyph_evidence hashes and are not claimed to be absent ink.
